reason: The analyst ran one unadjusted regression (2.16) with no controls for confounders such as firm size, age and prior productivity, and also trimmed the outcome. My analysis shows adjusting for the 2020 pre-period covariates cuts the effect about fourfold, to roughly 0.58 (95% CI 0.12 to 1.04), so the reported estimate is badly inflated by confounding.
